description: This source file contains unit tests for the NodeAppModel component of a Swift-based iOS application, focusing on deep linking, message handling, watch notifications, and UI actions.

classes.name: NodeAppModelInvokeTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests for NodeAppModel, focusing on deep linking, message interactions, watch notifications, and UI commands.

classes.name: MockWatchMessagingService
classes.description: Mock implementation of WatchMessagingServicing protocol for testing watch-related functionalities.

classes.name: MockBootstrapNotificationCenter
classes.description: Mock implementation of NotificationCentering protocol to simulate notification authorization behavior in tests.

methods.name: decodeParamsFailsWithoutJSON
methods.description: Tests that decoding parameters fails when no JSON data is provided.

methods.name: encodePayloadEmitsJSON
methods.description: Tests that encoding a payload emits valid JSON containing the expected fields.

methods.name: chatSessionKeyDefaultsToMainBase
methods.description: Verifies that the chat session key defaults to 'main' when not explicitly set.

methods.name: chatSessionKeyUsesAgentScopedKeyForNonDefaultAgent
methods.description: Checks that the session key uses the agent-specific key when a non-default agent is selected.

methods.name: operatorLoopWaitsForBootstrapHandoffBeforeUsingStoredToken
methods.description: Ensures that the operator loop waits for bootstrap handoff before starting if a bootstrap token is present.

methods.name: successfulBootstrapOnboardingRequestsNotificationAuthorization
methods.description: Validates that notification authorization is requested upon successful bootstrap onboarding.

methods.name: clearingBootstrapTokenStripsReconnectConfigEvenWithoutPersistence
methods.description: Tests that clearing the bootstrap token removes it from the configuration without affecting other connection parameters.

methods.name: handleInvokeRejectsBackgroundCommands
methods.description: Checks that invoke requests for background commands are rejected with an error.

methods.name: handleInvokeRejectsCameraWhenDisabled
methods.description: Verifies that camera commands are rejected if camera access is disabled in user defaults.

methods.name: handleInvokeRejectsInvalidScreenFormat
methods.description: Ensures that screen recording commands with invalid formats are rejected with an error.

methods.name: handleInvokeCanvasCommandsUpdateScreen
methods.description: Tests that canvas commands for navigation, evaluation, and screen update are handled correctly.

methods.name: pendingForegroundActionsReplayCanvasNavigate
methods.description: Verifies that pending foreground navigation actions are applied correctly.

methods.name: pendingForegroundActionsDoNotApplyWhileBackgrounded
methods.description: Confirms that foreground actions are not applied when the app is in background.

methods.name: handleInvokeA2UICommandsFailWhenHostMissing
methods.description: Checks that A2UI commands fail if the host configuration is missing.

methods.name: handleInvokeUnknownCommandReturnsInvalidRequest
methods.description: Ensures unknown commands are rejected with an invalid request error.

methods.name: handleInvokeWatchStatusReturnsServiceSnapshot
methods.description: Tests that the watch status retrieval returns the current status correctly.

methods.name: handleInvokeWatchNotifyRoutesToWatchService
methods.description: Verifies that watch notification requests are routed to the watch messaging service and the payload is correct.

methods.name: handleInvokeWatchNotifyRejectsEmptyMessage
methods.description: Ensures empty or invalid message content is rejected.

methods.name: handleInvokeWatchNotifyAddsDefaultActionsForPrompt
methods.description: Tests that default actions are added to notifications when prompted.

methods.name: handleInvokeWatchNotifyAddsApprovalDefaults
methods.description: Verifies default approval actions are added for approval prompts.

methods.name: handleInvokeWatchNotifyDerivesPriorityFromRiskAndCapsActions
methods.description: Checks that notification priority and risk are derived properly based on parameters.

methods.name: handleInvokeWatchNotifyReturnsUnavailableOnDeliveryFailure
methods.description: Ensures that delivery failures produce an 'unavailable' error.

methods.name: watchReplyQueuesWhenGatewayOffline
methods.description: Verifies that watch replies are queued when the gateway is offline.

methods.name: handleDeepLinkSetsErrorWhenNotConnected
methods.description: Checks that deep links fail when the gateway is not connected.

methods.name: handleDeepLinkRejectsOversizedMessage
methods.description: Ensures that messages exceeding size limits are rejected.

methods.name: handleDeepLinkRequiresConfirmationWhenConnectedAndUnkeyed
methods.description: Verifies user confirmation prompt when deep linking with an unkeyed connection.

methods.name: handleDeepLinkCoalescesPromptWhenRateLimited
methods.description: Ensures multiple deep link prompts are coalesced to prevent spamming.

methods.name: handleDeepLinkStripsDeliveryFieldsWhenUnkeyed
methods.description: Tests that delivery-related fields are stripped when unkeyed.

methods.name: handleDeepLinkRejectsLongUnkeyedMessageWhenConnected
methods.description: Checks that long messages are blocked in unkeyed state.

methods.name: handleDeepLinkBypassesPromptWithValidKey
methods.description: Verifies trusted deep link requests bypass confirmation when a valid key is provided.

methods.name: sendVoiceTranscriptThrowsWhenGatewayOffline
methods.description: Ensures sending voice transcript throws an error if gateway is offline.

methods.name: canvasA2UIActionDispatchesStatus
methods.description: Tests dispatching of A2 UI actions from canvas.
